description: The State of Wildfires research team publishes annual population and physical-asset exposure summaries for burned areas, together with final-year anomalies and rankings. Two CSV tables combine MODIS burned-area observations since 2002 with static 2018 LitPop exposure from CLIMADA. Results are grouped by country, administrative region, biome and other regional schemes, using March-to-February fire seasons through February 2025. Zenodo offers the tables publicly and free under CC-BY-4.0. A limitation is that exposed assets are not observed losses, and holding exposure at 2018 conditions does not represent population or asset growth over the entire record. The metadata also retains unresolved article-citation placeholders. The summaries can benchmark regional wildfire exposure simulations and support emergency-planning comparisons. They complement the underlying burned-area maps and CLIMADA exposure layers with consistent regional aggregation. No damage model was run and no tables were downloaded.
